messages:
alex_cheng: Morning — CI turned red on hosted integration suite. 6 fails in job https://github.com/redwood/inference/actions/runs/987654321 (hosted-integ). Failing tests look related to auth handshake + streaming tool plugin schema.

ci-bot: Build 987654321 failed on shard 4. Tests failed: test_toolchain_stream_handshake, test_streaming_plugin_auth, test_schema_roundtrip_tool, test_tool_invoke_retry, test_kv_cache_stream_frag, test_tool_sig_mismatch.

priya_singh: Ack. Re-ran the job locally on my laptop with the same env and see the handshake 401 in the streamer: `HTTP 401 - invalid token` after 10s. Log snippet:
```
E 12:03:44 stream: handshake failed status=401 body={"error":"invalid_session"}
E 12:03:44 tool: plugin rejected auth flow: token_missing
```

mike_hansen: Can someone queue a rerun on shard 4? If it's flaky we should bisect the recent changes to hosted-proxy and stream-runtime.

jen_ops: Rerun queued (job 987654330). Also adding `INTEGRATION_VERBOSE=1` to the rerun so we get more detailed logs. @mike_hansen @alex_cheng can you add which commits to bisect if it stays red?

alex_cheng: Thanks. Suspect recent PRs: `patch/stream-auth-fix` (merged yesterday) and `ci/proxy-timeout` (merged 2 days ago). If rerun stays red I'll start a git bisect across those two merges.

priya_singh: FYI I reproduced a schema error locally from the plugin: schema version header was `x-tool-schema: 2023-10-01` but the runtime expects `2024-01-01` — that's probably why `test_schema_roundtrip_tool` fails. The plugin bumped schema in #5022. @mike_hansen can we try pinning plugin to previous schema as a quick workaround?

mike_hansen: I'll try a hotfix build of the plugin pinned to `v1.13.2` and run the failing integration tests against hosted in a dry-run. If that fixes it we can do an emergency rollback of plugin in staging.

jen_ops: If we need a temporary skip, please do `pytest -m "not critical"` or add `@pytest.mark.xfail(reason="temp hosted schema mismatch", strict=False)` to avoid blocking release. But prefer rollback or bisect first.

alex_cheng: Rerun finished: job 987654330 is still red. New failure pattern: handshake 401 + schema mismatch on tool signature. Looks deterministic on this shard.

mike_hansen: I'm starting a bisect now between commits `a1b2c3d` (before patch) and `f7e8g9h` (after merges). I'll report progress.

ci-bot: Started bisect job 987654400 by mike_hansen.

priya_singh: I'll open a short PR to add extra logging for `SessionManager` handshake responses so bisect has better info.

alex_cheng: Cool — @mike_hansen ping me if you need a rerun or a local docker image to reproduce faster.

mike_hansen: Will do. ETA 30m for first bisect step. I'll post updates and the sha that flips.

jen_ops: Thanks team — keeping this thread updated helps releases. :thumbsup:

mike_hansen: Update: bisect found the culprit — merge `patch/stream-auth-fix` introduced a header ordering change that broke plugin's schema check. Reproduced locally with pinned plugin v1.13.3.

alex_cheng: Great find. What's the mitigation? rollback patch or make plugin tolerant of header order?

mike_hansen: Propose revert of `patch/stream-auth-fix` in hosted-proxy for now (fast) and open follow-up to make schema parsing robust (longer fix).

priya_singh: I'll cut the revert PR and request an emergency deploy to staging. Also adding a test that validates header ordering isn't required.

jen_ops: Revert PR opened and flagged as emergency. I'll start the staging deploy pipeline now.

alex_cheng: Thanks everyone. I'll keep monitoring. If staging looks good we can cherry-pick to prod rollout. Closing loop in a few hours.

mike_hansen: Closing bisect, leaving notes in the PR. @ci-bot please annotate the original failure with the bisect result.

ci-bot: Annotated build 987654321 with bisect result: culprit=a1b2c3d..f7e8g9h (patch/stream-auth-fix).
